pipelineSteps.detail: Our systems architects conduct an in-depth infrastructure audit of your current stack, size your compute/storage needs, and structure a custom sovereign architecture agreement.
Our engineering team manually provisions, configures, and isolates your dedicated tenant cluster. We configure network perimeters, Ceph storage fabrics, and zero-trust policies by hand.
Engineers set up your central Authentik SSO directory, configure enterprise MFA, link custom corporate domains, and verify TLS 1.3 certificates and access controls.
Following comprehensive pre-flight verification, your team receives turnkey InsightOS credentials. Our SRE team monitors host health, backups, and security 24/7.

faqs.question: How do you handle disaster recovery if a local African data center goes offline?
faqs.answer: For Tier 5 deployments, we use Velero and Kopia to take encrypted, deduplicated snapshots of the entire Kubernetes cluster and push them to a secondary S3-compatible target—either another local provider (e.g., Angani → LiquidC2) or an offshore backup (Hetzner), depending on the client's strict data residency guidelines. RPO is under 15 minutes, with automated RTO recovery drills.

faqs.question: Can our organization upgrade from Tier 2 to Tier 4 without losing historical data?
faqs.answer: Yes, seamlessly. Because our entire architecture is modular, declarative, and containerized, moving up a tier simply means our engineering team provisions the new container services (e.g., Dittofeed, Documenso) directly into your existing client namespace and syncs the new access privileges via Authentik. No database migrations, downtime, or vendor export penalties are involved.

faqs.question: Why do you use Proxmox VE under Kubernetes for Tier 5 instead of running Kubernetes directly on bare metal?
faqs.answer: Proxmox provides host-level abstraction and resilience. If a Kubernetes control-plane node fails completely, we can restore the entire VM instantly via Proxmox Backup Server (PBS). It also allows us to run high-IOPS storage engines (like Ceph) and databases in ultra-low overhead bare-metal LXC containers, while keeping Kubernetes dedicated strictly for elastic stateless services and AI inference.

faqs.question: How does Julz Insight ensure compliance with the Kenya Data Protection Act 2019 and GDPR?
faqs.answer: By housing 100% of production data within Kenyan and African borders (Safaricom, Konza, Angani, or on-premise), you eliminate cross-border data transfer legal liabilities. Furthermore, Wazuh SIEM continuously audits access logs, Authentik provides tamper-evident audit trails, and Nextcloud/ONLYOFFICE ensure files are encrypted at rest with AES-256.

faqs.question: What is the ROI comparison between Julz Insight and foreign SaaS platforms like Microsoft 365 or Salesforce?
faqs.answer: Most African enterprises experience a 65% to 85% net reduction in total cost of ownership (TCO) over 24 months. Proprietary SaaS vendors charge per-user, per-month in foreign exchange (USD), subjecting your budget to local currency devaluations. Julz Insight charges transparent flat or tiered monthly retainers in local currency (KES) with predictable SLAs and zero per-seat licensing penalties.
